requirement.text: The system shall be easy to learn

classification.rationale: Neither the target requirement nor the surrounding document context contains specific signals indicating a web, mobile, or AI-driven system. It is a general usability requirement, so it is classified as 'other'.

rounds.text_checked: The system shall be easy to learn

issues.explanation: The phrase 'easy to learn' contains a vague adjective with no measurable threshold or quantifiable benchmark to determine pass/fail criteria.

questions.question_text: What specific, quantifiable criteria or benchmark (such as maximum training time required or task success rate for new users) should be used to define 'easy to learn'?

answers.answer_text: No document-defined threshold exists. Proposing: a first-time user, given no prior training, can locate and complete a standard task (e.g. placing an order) within 10 minutes using only in-app help bubbles, with no external documentation required.

test_strategy.rationale: 'performance' is selected due to the explicit timing constraint requiring task completion within 10 minutes. 'use_case' is selected because the requirement describes a multi-step user scenario (a first-time user locating and completing a standard task like placing an order using in-app help). 'boundary_value_analysis' and 'equivalence_partitioning' are selected due to the explicit numeric threshold of 10 minutes for evaluation.

test_cases.title: First-time user locates and completes standard task using in-app help bubbles
test_cases.preconditions: User account is newly created; user has received no prior system training and has no access to external documentation.
steps: Log into the application as a first-time user.
Initiate a standard task (placing an order) without referencing external documentation.
Follow the guidance provided exclusively by in-app help bubbles to locate task elements.
Complete all required fields and submit the order.
test_cases.expected_result: The user successfully locates and completes the order placement task using only in-app help bubbles within 10 minutes.

test_cases.title: Boundary analysis for task completion time limit at 10 minutes
test_cases.preconditions: First-time user environment initialized with continuous timer logging.
steps: Start the test timer immediately upon the first-time user entering the application.
Instruct the user to locate and complete a standard order placement task using only in-app help bubbles.
Record the exact timestamp when the order confirmation is displayed.
test_cases.expected_result: The duration from initiation to completion is measured and verified to be less than or equal to 10 minutes (600 seconds).

test_cases.title: Equivalence partitioning for task guidance sources (In-App Help vs External Documentation)
test_cases.preconditions: First-time user logged in with external documentation access blocked.
steps: Present the user with a standard system task (placing an order).
Ensure all external help links and documentation are disabled/unavailable.
Observe the user complete the task using the valid partition of help resources (in-app help bubbles).
test_cases.expected_result: The task is successfully completed reliance-free on external documentation, staying fully within the valid in-app guidance partition within 10 minutes.

test_cases.title: Performance timing measurement for standard task completion by untrained user
test_cases.preconditions: Test harness configured to capture detailed time-to-complete metrics for workflow steps.
steps: Begin monitoring system performance and user interaction timers.
Prompt an untrained first-time user to locate the order feature.
Track time elapsed while the user reads help bubbles and progresses through order creation.
Stop timer upon final order confirmation.
test_cases.expected_result: Total performance time for task discovery and execution does not exceed the maximum allowed threshold of 10 minutes.

final_text: The system shall allow a first-time user, given no prior training, to locate and complete a standard task (e.g., placing an order) within 10 minutes using only in-app help bubbles, with no external documentation required.
